title: Critical Looping Velocities for Vertical Circle with String
equation_latex: v_{\text{bot,min}} = \sqrt{5 g R}, \quad v_{\text{top,min}} = \sqrt{g R}, \quad T_{\text{bot}} - T_{\text{top}} = 6 mg

variables.v_{\\text{bot,min}}: Minimum speed at lowest point to complete vertical loop
variables.v_{\\text{top,min}}: Minimum speed at highest point (apex) without slackening
variables.R: Radius of circular path (length of string)

conditions_of_validity: String tension T >= 0 everywhere on trajectory
common_misuse: Using v_bot = sqrt(4gR) for string instead of rigid rod
Assuming apex speed can be zero with a string
